characteristic_number_corollary.conclusion: For t in J_k, alpha^t=1 mod 2 and beta(t) mod P belongs to mu_q for every P|2.
characteristic_number_corollary.obstruction: The q-th-power identity is blind modulo 2 and cannot itself prove that beta(t) mod P is nontrivial.

finite_audit.interpretation: Finite replay of the group-ring identity; not a substitute for the symbolic proof.

graph_or_ray_class_dichotomy.lattice: M_p={theta in I_0: relative_weight(theta) is even}.
graph_or_ray_class_dichotomy.nonzero_branch: If beta(t) mod P is nontrivial for some P,t, then ord_q(2)|ord_p(2) with odd quotient.
graph_or_ray_class_dichotomy.ray_annihilator: The ray class [A]_m lies in R_p={c in Cl_m(K):c^theta=1 for all theta in M_p}, where M_p=<J>_Z.
graph_or_ray_class_dichotomy.zero_branch: If all residues are trivial, then beta(t)=1 modulo m=2*O_K*(1-zeta)^2 for every t in J.

imported_source_facts: definitions of I, I_0, J_k and phi

mod2_collapse_theorem.hypothesis: theta is a positive Stickelberger element with (1+j)theta=r*N

new_direction.replacement_target: Compute and control R_p uniformly using the ray-class exact sequence, G-character decomposition, Stickelberger annihilation, and reflection.
new_direction.uniform_shape: Every repeated-prime counterexample is either on a well-founded exponent graph or in a finite ray-class annihilator branch.
new_direction.withdrawn_target: Do not try to prove nonvanishing from alpha^t mod 2.

nonclaim: This does not prove the repeated-prime family or Beal. It proves the mod-2 collapse and the exact graph-or-ray-class reduction from the cited Jacobi/Stickelberger construction.
